source.method: Shopify Admin GraphQL through the Shopify connector (graphql_query, read-only). No mutations.
source.personalData: None. No customer, order, staff or author fields were queried.

notes: The pinned Admin API schema has no Collection.ruleSet field; smart rules are exposed as Collection.sources (CollectionConditionsSource).
ruleSet is derived from sources in the CollectionRuleSetInput shape (TAGGED_WITH -> TAG EQUALS) so it can be used to recreate a collection. sources is the raw API data and wins if they disagree.
collectionType comes from the collections query filters collection_type:smart and collection_type:custom.
products lists every member in any status, so DRAFT and ARCHIVED products appear where a rule matches them.
Collection publications only support APP catalogs, so there are no market catalog entries here.
